verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, Venerable Rādha said to the Buddha:
“Sir, they speak of a ‘liability to originate’.
What has a liability to originate?”

verses.pali: “Rūpaṁ kho, rādha, samudayadhammo, vedanā samudayadhammo, saññā samudayadhammo, saṅkhārā samudayadhammo, viññāṇaṁ samudayadhammo.
verses.english: “Rādha, form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness have a liability to originate.
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
